financings_after_balance_sheet.what: January 2026 registered direct offering of common stock, pre-funded warrants and series warrants; $50.0M gross less ~$350K estimated expenses
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The gross proceeds to us before expenses will be approximately $50.0 million. We estimate the total expenses of this offering will be approximately $350,000.

warrants.quote: Each Series 1 Warrant has an initial exercise price of $13.42 per share of Common Stock, subject to certain adjustments, and expires on June 30, 2027.
Each Series 2 Warrant has an initial exercise price of $20.13 per share of Common Stock, subject to certain adjustments, and expires on December 31, 2030.
The Pre-Funded Warrants were exercisable immediately upon issuance at an initial exercise price of $0.0001 per share and have a term of 20 years.
